description: Save a city or country to the member's Nomads.com favorites (the heart on the site). Authenticated as the member, like get_favorites.

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

slug.description: A city slug from search_cities (e.g. lisbon-portugal) or a country slug (e.g. portugal)

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: add_favorite
